pin: Every pin is {path:absolute-string,bytes:int,sha256:lowerhex64}; hash raw stored bytes, including gzip wrapper when applicable.

keys.source_pins: map new filename->pin, including reader and every synthetic test
keys.input_specs: map fit string->map model,data,teacher,reconstruction,family,publics -> pin, consumed by input_contract.load_fit
keys.schedule_fields: 13 semantic public fields from old hash inventory
keys.review_pins: static review and synthetic qualification pins
keys.provenance_sources: Original causal_core/task_graph/full_MLP source plus current applicable AGENTS pins; metadata audit only, never execute entrypoints.

model_entry.model_pin: full candidate JSON.gz pin; KEEP uses exact byte copy of original C
model_entry.readout_sha256: sha256 of F64 little-endian w2 rowmajor192 then b2_4
model_entry.canonical_model_sha256: sha256 canonical decoded JSON; models with same readout and same protected anchor can alias

graph_file: main_attempt001/graphs/fit_{fit}/world_{index:03d}.json.gz; dictionary returned by value_graph.build: schema,public,keys,states,masks,posterior,terminal,edges,qstar,optimal_values,order,initial,state_order_sha256,probability_error. edges[state][action-1] ordered (probability,target,fee) for1/2/3.
hidden_cache: main_attempt001/features/fit_{fit}.npz arrays H (all TRAIN rows x49); pin recorded in main fit entry. Reader must reconstruct original hidden from original X/base rather than trust this array.

keys.models: map arm ID->model_entry used in phase
keys.arrays_pin: one npz for entire fit/phase or fit/domain
keys.worlds: list of world records defined below
keys.means: map arm->equal-world means including utility/optimal_utility/delta and diagnostic summaries
keys.CPU_seconds: actual whole phase elapsed process CPU, no clipping
keys.evaluation_CPU_by_arm: measured scoring/DP per unique arm; aliases0, sharedI/O separate
keys.started_utc: ISO UTC at this phase entry; GEN incumbent prior evaluation is explicitly pinned when reused.
keys.completed_utc: ISO UTC after array serialization, before final record JSON tail.
keys.precomputed_KEEP_record_pin: GEN only: pin of preparation/fit_{fit}_GEN_KEEP.json with phase GEN_INCUMBENT_ONLY and same complete worlds/model. Its score/DP results reused, cost paid exactly once.

world_record.arms: map arm->{metrics:value_graph.evaluate report, array_prefix:string, alias_of:null|earlier unique arm, evaluation_CPU_seconds:actual scoring+DP CPU}. metrics include complete J,own optimum,PDI,terminal mass,cost,counts,score-derived Brier and terminal ranking diagnostics. KEEP computed first and its actual occupancy supplied for all candidate common-weight diagnostics.
world_record.features_pin: CONF only: pin of original semantic X/H npz, plural field name.

array_contract.shapes: scores[n,6]; other arrays[n]. Actions int64, all othersfloat64; full state order including zero incumbent occupancy. Aliases share prefix; no fabricated rerun.
array_contract.no_hidden_quality_read: Generation receives GEN slices only; phase files are outputs, not optimizer inputs.

family_generation: generation/fit_{fit}_{Q|B|G|T}.json schema hepta-value-family-generation-v1; fit,family,started_utc,completed_utc,protocol_sha256,source_model_pin,problem_pin,screening_pin,raw_payloads_pin,emitted_model_pins,readout_work_delta,checkpoints,CPU_seconds,wall_seconds,nominal_CPU_cap. checkpoints contains every registered slot actual status/residuals/elapsed/acceptance. Optional raw NPZ names {candidate_id}__primal and __dual. slots in main link generation_record_pin, status VALID or UNKNOWN, original checkpoint_report and optional model_pin. Additional lifecycle_CPU_through_record,numerical_call_CPU_seconds,artifact_and_revalidation_CPU_seconds,other_family_bookkeeping_CPU_seconds and lifecycle_scope expose per-family numerical versus saved-artifact work; final record-write tail remains measured in MAIN process.

keys.fits: fit->{models:all valid KEEP+7optimized heads, candidate_slots:all7 statuses, family_choice:{Q,B,G,T}:actual ID, global_choice:actual ID, GEN_record_pin,SELECT_record_pin,SELECT_means:map ID->utility, graph_manifest_pin,hidden_pin,screening_pin}

diagnostic_seal.definition: Retain selectedG Q with originalB, or selectedG B with originalQ. Exact check, never select, no native intent.

keys.status: COMPLETED only if all source/graph/AUDIT requirements met; subcandidate numerical UNKNOWN may exist explicitly
keys.resources: actual child CPU/wall/peakRSS; allocation/raw observations separate
keys.completed_utc: ISO UTC after all required audits and final original pin checks.

keys.main_process_pin: Pin to successful parent MAIN PROCESS.json; entropy creation follows its completion.

CONF_records.features: confirm_attempt001/features/fit_{fit}_{domain}_{index:03d}.npz with X,H, both original semantic model; pin in CONF world record
CONF_records.phase_records: confirm_attempt001/records/fit_{fit}_{iid|ood}.json, same phase schema with domain; arms KEEP,Q_SELECTED,B_SELECTED,G_SELECTED,T_SELECTED,G_WITH_ORIGINAL_B,G_WITH_ORIGINAL_Q. Each model_entry also has selected_candidate_id. Global alias saved explicitly.

keys.primary: four registered paired contrasts, fivefitvalues/mean/SD/SE/range/familywise95 df4 Bonferroni

failure_contract: Every phase outputdirectory create-only. STARTED.json beforework; FAILED.json for technical/timeout failure, partial retained. CONF requires mainRESULTS status COMPLETED, all input/source/model/selection/diagnostic pins reverified, not merely an existing seal.
reader_contract: Independent raw model/head/GEN source/choice/PDI/norm/phase verification. Reuse reviewed original semantic definitions and graph reconstruction for source alignment, independently implement head and scalar policy/occupancy/gap/Fraction arithmetic. Independently reconstruct all80 CONF complete X/H (<=327680 rows) plus separate original recursive+semantic execution for80 global policies (<=327680 cached feature rows). Count actual physical, public-feature, hidden, recursive work; no optimizer imports, unbounded replay or result-driven extra checks.
cost_scope: Per-unique-arm scoring/DP CPU observed directly; shared coldinputs/DAG/H/screening/I/O/selection/seal CPU retained as separate measured/common scope. For G/T comparison allocate per-fit common research preparation equally across4 candidate families, show raw totals andallocation; do not claim allocated cost is physical per-candidate work. All phases andfailures count, unknown unmetered overhead remainsunknown.
screening: screening/fit_{fit}.json schema hepta-value-gen-screening-v1 contains screen report selected rows/proxy mass/global row ids/selectedH hash plus fit,GEN_world_indices,protocol_sha256,problem_pin,incumbent_record_pin,source_input_pins,exact_radius. problem NPZ arrays H,masks,targets,margins; only GEN selected rows.
